description: Every code the OpenQASM reader gives (each refusal and warning carries one, as `[Q103]` at the end of its message): its outcome (refused, lowered, carried, preserved or warned) and its meaning; and beside them, under job_codes, the codes of what is asked of a program (`[J011]`: the request, the method, an intent, a repair, the host). A code never changes meaning once released. Give `code` for one of either.

code.description: One code, as Q103 or J011.

name: qasm_diagnostics

items.description: A row of a table of codes, the reader's (Q…) or the job layer's (J…): a code, its outcome, its meaning, and whether it is retired (a retired code keeps its row and its meaning, and nothing gives it).

table.description: Which table the code is in: the reader's (Q…) or the job layer's (J…).

job_codes.description: The job layer's codes (J…): what a host refuses of a job it read, and why.
